an6.60:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Bārāṇasiyaṃ viharati Isipatane Migadāye.
an6.60:1.3: Tena kho pana samayena sambahulā therā bhikkhū pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkantā maṇḍalamāḷe sannisinnā sannipatitā abhidhammakathaṃ kathenti.
an6.60:1.4: Tatra sudaṃ āyasmā Citto Hatthisāriputto therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ abhidhammakathaṃ kathentānaṃ antarantarā kathaṃ opāteti.
an6.60:1.5: Atha kho āyasmā Mahākoṭṭhito āyasmantaṃ Cittaṃ Hatthisāriputtaṃ etad avoca ‘mā
an6.60:1.6: āyasmā Citto Hatthisāriputto therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ abhidhammakathaṃ kathentānaṃ antarantarā kathaṃ opātesi, kathāpariyosānaṃ āyasmā Citto āgametū' ti.
an6.60:1.7: Evaṃ vutte āyasmato Cittassa Hatthisāriputtassa sahāyakā bhikkhū āyasmantaṃ Mahākoṭṭhitaṃ etad avocuṃ ‘mā
an6.60:1.8: āyasmā Koṭṭhito āyasmantaṃ Cittaṃ Hatthisāriputtaṃ apasādesi. Paṇḍito āyasmā Citto Hatthisāriputto
an6.60:1.9: pahoti c' āyasmā Citto Hatthisāriputto therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ abhidhammakathaṃ kathetun' ti.
an6.60:2.1: Dujjānaṃ kho etaṃ āvuso parassa cetopariyāyaṃ ajānantehi. 2.
an6.60:2.2: Idhāvuso ekacco puggalo tāva-d-eva soratasorato hoti nivātanivāto hoti upasantupasanto hoti, yāva Satthāraṃ upanissāya viharati aññataraṃ vā garuṭṭhāniyaṃ sabrahmacāriṃ.
an6.60:2.3: Yato ca kho so vapakassat'eva Satthārā, vapakassati garuṭṭhāniyehi sabrahmacārīhi, so saṃsaṭṭho viharati bhikkhūhi bhikkhunīhi upāsakehi upāsikāhi raññā rājamahāmattehi titthiyehi titthiyasāvakehi,
an6.60:2.4: tassa saṃsaṭṭhassa vissaṭṭhassa pākaṭassa bhassam anuyuttassa viharato rāgo cittaṃ anuddhaṃseti,
an6.60:2.5: so rāgānuddhaṃsena cittena sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattati.
an6.60:3.1: Seyyathā pi āvuso goṇo kiṭṭhādo dāmena vā baddho vaje vā oruddho,
an6.60:3.2: yo nu kho āvuso evaṃ vadeyya "na dānāyaṃ goṇo kiṭṭhādo puna-d-eva kiṭṭhaṃ otarissatī" ti, sammā nu kho so āvuso vadamāno vadeyyā ti?
an6.60:3.4: ṭhānaṃ h'etaṃ āvuso vijjati, yaṃ so goṇo kiṭṭhādo dāmaṃ vā chetvā vajaṃ vā bhinditvā puna-d-eva kiṭṭhaṃ otareyyā' ti. Evam
an6.60:3.5: eva kho āvuso idh' ekacco puggalo tāva-d-eva soratasorato hoti nivātanivāto hoti upasantupasanto hoti, yāva Satthāraṃ upanissāya viharati aññataraṃ vā garuṭṭhāniyaṃ sabrahmacāriṃ.
an6.60:3.6: Yato ca kho so vapakassat'eva Satthārā, vapakassati garuṭṭhāniyehi sabrahmacārīhi, so saṃsaṭṭho viharati bhikkhūhi bhikkhunīhi upāsakehi upāsikāhi raññā rājamahāmattehi titthiyehi titthiyasāvakehi,
an6.60:3.7: tassa saṃsaṭṭhassa vissaṭṭhassa pākaṭassa bhassam anuyuttassa viharato rāgo cittaṃ anuddhaṃseti,
an6.60:3.8: so rāgānuddhaṃsena cittena sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattati. 3.
an6.60:4.1: Idha panāvuso ekacco puggalo vivicc'eva kāmehi . . . pe . . . paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati,
an6.60:4.2: so ‘lābhī 'mhi paṭhamassa jhānassā' ti saṃsaṭṭho viharati bhikkhūhi . . . pe . . .
an6.60:4.4: Seyyathā pi āvuso cātummahāpathe thullaphusitako devo vassanto rajaṃ antaradhāpeyya cikkhallaṃ pātukareyya,
an6.60:4.5: yo nu kho āvuso evaṃ vadeyya "na dāni amusmiṃ cātummahāpathe puna-d-eva rajo pātubhavissatī" ti, sammā nu kho so āvuso vadamāno vadeyyā ti?
an6.60:4.7: ṭhānaṃ h'etaṃ āvuso vijjati, yaṃ amusmiṃ cātummahāpathe manussā vā atikkameyyuṃ. gopasū vā atikkameyyuṃ vātātapo vā snehagataṃ pariyādiyeyya, atha puna-d-eva rajo pātubhaveyyā' ti. Evam
an6.60:4.8: eva kho āvuso idh' ekacco puggalo vivicc'eva kāmehi . . . pe . . . paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati,
an6.60:4.9: so ‘lābhī 'mhi paṭhamassa jhānassā' ti saṃsaṭṭho viharati bhikkhūhi . . . pe . . .
an6.60:5.1: Idha panāvuso ekacco puggalo vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā . . . pe . . . dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati,
an6.60:5.2: so ‘lābhī 'mhi dutiyassa jhānassā' ti saṃsaṭṭho viharati bhikkhūhi . . . pe . . .
an6.60:5.4: Seyyathā pi āvuso gāmassa vā nigamassa vā avidūre mahantaṃ taḷākaṃ,
an6.60:5.5: tattha thullaphusitako devo vuṭṭho sippisambukam pi sakkharakaṭhalam pi antaradhāpeyya,
an6.60:5.6: yo nu kho āvuso evaṃ vadeyya "na dāni amusmiṃ taḷāke puna-d-eva sippisambukā vā sakkharakaṭhalā vā pātubhavissantī" ti, sammā nu kho so āvuso vadamāno vadeyyā ti?
an6.60:5.8: ṭhānaṃ h'etaṃ āvuso vijjati, yaṃ amusmiṃ taḷāke manussā vā piveyyuṃ gopasū vā piveyyuṃ vātātapo vā snehagataṃ pariyādiyeyya, atha puna-d-eva sippisambukā pi sakkharakaṭhalā pi pātubhaveyyun' ti. Evam
an6.60:5.9: eva kho āvuso idh' ekacco puggalo vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā . . . pe . . . dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati,
an6.60:5.10: so ‘lābhī 'mhi dutiyassa jhānassā' ti saṃsaṭṭho viharati bhikkhūhi . . . pe . . .
an6.60:6.1: Idha panāvuso ekacco puggalo pītiyā ca virāgā . . . pe . . . tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati,
an6.60:6.2: so ‘lābhī 'mhi tatiyassa jhānassā' ti saṃsaṭṭho viharati bhikkhūhi . . . pe . . .
an6.60:6.4: Seyyathā pi āvuso purisaṃ paṇītabhojanaṃ bhuttāviṃ abhidosikaṃ bhojanaṃ na cchādeyya,
an6.60:6.5: yo nu kho āvuso evaṃ vadeyya "na dāni amuṃ purisaṃ puna-d-eva bhojanaṃ chādessatī" ti, sammā nu kho so āvuso vadamāno vadeyyā ti?
an6.60:6.7: ṭhānaṃ h'etaṃ āvuso vijjati, amuṃ h' āvuso purisaṃ paṇītabhojanaṃ bhuttāviṃ yāv' assa sā ojā kāye ṭhassati, tāva na aññaṃ bhojanaṃ chādessati,
an6.60:6.8: yato ca khvassa sā ojā antaradhāyissati, atha puna-d-eva taṃ bhojanaṃ chādeyyā' ti. Evam
an6.60:6.9: eva kho āvuso idh' ekacco puggalo pītiyā ca virāgā . . . pe . . . tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati,
an6.60:6.10: so ‘lābhī 'mhi tatiyassa jhānassā' ti saṃsaṭṭho viharati bhikkhūhi . . . pe . . .
an6.60:7.1: Idha panāvuso ekacco puggalo sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā . . . pe . . . catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati,
an6.60:7.2: so ‘lābhī 'mhi catutthassa jhānassā' ti saṃsaṭṭho viharati bhikkhūhi . . . pe . . .
an6.60:7.4: Seyyathā pi āvuso pabbatasaṃkhepe udakarahado nivāto vigata-ūmiko,
an6.60:7.5: yo nu kho āvuso evaṃ vadeyya "na dāni amusmiṃ udakarahade puna-d-eva ūmi pātubhavissatī" ti, sammā nu kho so āvuso vadamāno vadeyyā ti?
an6.60:7.7: thānaṃ h'etaṃ āvuso vijjati, yā puratthimāya disāya āgaccheyya bhusā vātavuṭṭhi, sā tasmiṃ udakarahade ūmiṃ janeyya, yā pacchimāya disāya āgaccheyya . . . pe . . . yā uttarāya disāya āgaccheyya . . . pe . . . yā dakkhiṇāya disāya āgaccheyya bhusā vātavuṭṭhi, sā tasmiṃ udakarahade ūmiṃ janeyyā' ti. Evam
an6.60:7.8: eva kho āvuso idh' ekacco puggalo sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā . . . pe . . . catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati,
an6.60:7.9: so ‘lābhī 'mhi catutthassa jhānassā' ti saṃsaṭṭho viharati bhikkhūhi . . . pe . . .
an6.60:8.1: Idha panāvuso ekacco puggalo sabbanimittānaṃ amanasikārā animittaṃ cetosamādhiṃ upasampajja viharati,
an6.60:8.2: so ‘lābhī 'mhi animittassa cetosamādhissā' ti saṃsaṭṭho viharati bhikkhūhi bhikkhunīhi upāsakehi upāsikāhi raññā rājamahāmattehi titthiyehi titthiyasāvakehi,
an6.60:8.3: tassa saṃsaṭṭhassa vissaṭṭhassa pākaṭassa bhassam anuyuttassa viharato rāgo cittaṃ anuddhaṃseti,
an6.60:8.4: so rāgānuddhaṃsena cittena sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattati.
an6.60:8.5: Seyyathā pi āvuso rājā vā rājamahāmatto vā caturaṅginiyā senāya addhānamaggapaṭipanno aññatarasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe ekarattiṃ vāsaṃ upagaccheyya,
an6.60:8.6: tattha hatthisaddena assasaddena rathasaddena pattisaddena bheripaṇavasaṅkhatiṇavaninnādasaddena cīriḷikāsaddo antaradhāpeyya,
an6.60:8.7: yo nu kho āvuso evaṃ vadeyya "na dāni amusmiṃ vanasaṇḍe puna-d-eva cīriḷikāsaddo pātubhavissatī" ti, sammā nu kho so āvuso vadamāno vadeyyā ti?
an6.60:8.9: ṭhānaṃ h'etaṃ āvuso vijjati, yaṃ so rājā vā rājamahāmatto vā tamhā vanasaṇḍā pakkameyya, atha puna-d-eva cīriḷikāsaddo pātubhaveyyā' ti. Evam
an6.60:8.10: eva kho āvuso idh' ekacco puggalo sabbanimittānaṃ amanasikārā animittaṃ cetosamādhiṃ upasampajja viharati,
an6.60:8.11: so ‘lābhī 'mhi animittassa cetosamādhissā' ti saṃsaṭṭho viharati bhikkhūhi bhikkhunīhi upāsakehi upāsikāhi raññā rājamahāmattehi titthiyehi titthiyasāvakehi,
an6.60:8.12: tassa saṃsaṭṭhassa vissaṭṭhassa pākaṭassa bhassam anuyuttassa viharato rāgo cittaṃ anuddhaṃseti,
an6.60:8.13: so rāgānuddhaṃsena cittena sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattatī ti. 8.
an6.60:9.1: Atha kho āyasmā Citto Hatthisāriputto aparena samayena sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattati.
an6.60:9.2: Atha kho Cittassa Hatthisāriputtassa sahāyakā bhikkhū yen' āyasmā Mahākoṭṭhito ten' upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Mohākoṭṭhitaṃ etad avocuṃ
an6.60:9.3: ‘kiṃ nu kho āyasmatā Mahākoṭṭhitena Citto Hatthisāriputto cetasā ceto paricca vidito:
an6.60:9.4: imāsañ ca imāsañ ca vihārasamāpattīnaṃ Citto Hatthisāriputto lābhī, atha ca pana sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattissatī ti,
an6.60:9.6: Citto bhante Hatthisāriputto imāsañ ca imāsañ ca vihārasamāpattīnaṃ lābhī, atha ca pana sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattissatī' ti?
an6.60:9.8: Citto Hatthisāriputto: imāsañ ca imāsañ ca vihārasamāpattīnaṃ lābhī, atha ca pana sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattissatī ti,
an6.60:9.9: devatā pi me etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ:
an6.60:9.10: Citto bhante Hatthisāriputto imāsañ ca imāsañ ca vihārasamāpattīnaṃ lābhī, atha ca pana sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattissatī' ti.
an6.60:10.1: Atha kho Cittassa Hatthisāriputtassa sahāyakā bhikkhū yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. Ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū Bhagavantaṃ etad avocuṃ
an6.60:10.2: ‘Citto bhante Hatthisāriputto imāsañ ca imāsañ ca vihārasamāpattīnaṃ lābhī, atha ca pana sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvatto' ti.
an6.60:10.3: ‘Na bhikkhave Citto ciraṃ sarissati nekkhammassā' ti. 9.
an6.60:11.1: Atha kho Citto Hatthisāriputto na cirass'eva kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbaji.
an6.60:11.2: Atha kho āyasmā Citto Hatthisāriputto eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto na cirass'eva yass' atthāya kulaputtā samma-d-eva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti, tad anuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭh'eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi,
an6.60:11.3: ‘khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyā' ti abbhaññāsi,
an6.60:11.4: aññataro ca panāyasmā Citto Hatthisāriputto arahataṃ ahosī
